title: Wire or remove committed-but-unbuilt coap sources: coap_codec.c, coap_blockwise.c, coap_waypoints.c, presence.c
description: Found during 4xln codereview. lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/ contains coap_codec.c, coap_blockwise.c, coap_waypoints.c, presence.c that are committed but not referenced by lichen/subsys/lichen/coap/CMakeLists.txt, so no build target compiles them (same class as commit 609a648228 'drop refs to unlanded WIP sources'; the sources were landed by 660b9bf3bf without CMake wiring). Also no Kconfig symbols gate them (no LICHEN_COAP_WAYPOINTS etc.). Decide per file: wire with proper Kconfig + fix any compile breaks they expose (use the qemu_x86 overlay-proof approach from bd 4xln), or remove the dead sources. Verify each choice with a build that includes it.
